weeks.focus: Problem solving under pressure works when you've already decided what you'll do before the pressure arrives. Know your muster point before the alarm. Know your role before the emergency.
weeks.moment: Brianda Sandoval — two crews aired the vessel to zero gas before anyone broke containment · Rolando Flores — pulled the whole crew into an LMRA huddle before work began

weeks.focus: Character is built when nobody is watching. Small deviations don't stay small. Correct them now, when the cost is low.
weeks.moment: The week the promise went up and the board flipped to fill rate — Cindy Smith at the top with 37 chances, 37 filled, never once blank · Stefanie Kirschke — continuous gas monitoring held through every disconnect she observed
